actions.create_survey_invitation_url.des: Generates a personalised, one-time-use survey link that you can send to a customer.
actions.create_survey_invitation_url.pro: Email address of the customer who will receive the survey link. The link is tied to this address.
Optional full name of the recipient. Used to personalise the survey experience.
Pick the survey to use. Surveys are created in your ProvenExpert account under the Surveys section.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_profile.description: Retrieves the company and contact details of your ProvenExpert profile.
actions.get_rating_summary.description: Retrieves the overall rating value and total review count for your ProvenExpert profile.
actions.list_surveys.description: Returns all surveys on your ProvenExpert profile with their codes, names, and share links.
actions.send_survey_invitation_email.des: Sends a survey invitation email through ProvenExpert to a single recipient. A 7-day reminder is sent automatically unless disabled.
actions.send_survey_invitation_email.pro: Email address that should receive the invitation.
Optional full name of the recipient — used to address them in the email.
Optional custom greeting line (e.g. "Hi Jane,"). Leave empty to use the survey default.
When enabled, ProvenExpert sends a reminder email after 7 days if the recipient has not responded.
Optional custom subject line for the invitation. Leave empty to use the survey default.
Pick the survey to use. Surveys are created in your ProvenExpert account under the Surveys section.
Optional custom message body. Leave empty to use the survey default body.
auth.description:
Connect your ProvenExpert account to access reviews, surveys, and invitations.

**How to get your API credentials:**
1. Log in to your [ProvenExpert account](https://www.provenexpert.com/).
2. Go to **integrations ** from the left side panel.
3.  Copy your **Username** and **API Key**.
4. Paste them into the fields below.
description: Collect customer reviews, send survey invitations, and pull rating data from ProvenExpert.
